notes: note: on the Channels > Chat tab, the status strip read 'Last loaded 4 minutes ago' on first load. After going to Settings > Integrations and back to Channels, the same strip briefly read 'Not loaded yet' (text was captured before the Installation tab finished loading). Probably a short loading state, but worth a look.

note: JRN-214 sweep covered Dashboard, Inbox, the 4 AI tabs, Guidance list, the 4 Channels tabs, the 4 Settings tabs, integration detail (shopify) and 404. It checked for banned words, uppercase letter-spaced overlines, left slivers (border-left >=3px) and that each page has an h1. The Guidance editor and the Agent no-access page were not swept. Agent access was covered by earlier checks (p9-nav-access-redirects, p5-access-states-tablet).
note: at 1024px the layout uses the lg breakpoint (preview beside settings). The 'Show preview' toggle was checked at 768 and 390, which matches 'under 1024'.
